reviews.text:
We’ve been using Paw Commons for years across a few of their San Diego locations, and they’ve consistently been our go-to for our (very) energetic dog, Roscoe.

Most recently, we brought him to the Hillcrest location just for grooming and a nail trim, and as always, the experience was smooth and professional. The team handled him with care and patience, which is no small feat given his personality, and he came back looking great.

We’ve also trusted Paw Commons with boarding during vacations, and that peace of mind is huge. It’s clear they take the time to understand each dog and make sure they’re comfortable, safe, and well cared for.

What really stands out is the consistency across locations and over time. No matter which Paw Commons we’ve visited, the staff has always been thoughtful, communicative, and genuinely caring.

Highly recommend to anyone looking for a place they can trust with their dog, whether it’s for grooming, daycare, or boarding.

Paw Commons in Hillcrest has an amazing staff that truly cares about their fur kids! Coco had her trial day today, and the team kept me informed throughout the day with updates and pictures, which gave me so much peace of mind.

My dogs Clara, Clover, and now Coco all love coming here. It’s clear that the staff genuinely cares for each dog and works hard to make them feel comfortable, safe, and happy. I highly recommend Paw Commons to anyone looking for a daycare or boarding  with caring people and excellent communication!

I absolutely loved the care my dog received. I found it extremely refreshing not to be worried about my pet on a vacation or travel. The report card system was absolutely fantastic getting to know how you dog’s day was and the enrichment walks is a must my husky was so excited she almost didn’t want to leave. I can not recommend this place enough.

Ok, so like, I was totally in the market for a new groomer, since my dog has too much of a winning personality and was banned from three petcos that are in wonderful commuting distances from my apartment. I felt lost and confused, like this situation was sooo not 6-7, and there was a high lack of riz. So, I took to the Google machine and found Paw Commons - Hillcrest! The entire process was easy. And when it was time to drop off my dog, I stared into the employees eyes, and asked them, are you totes ready for the time of your life? And they said, yes - with total confidence. My canine stylist, Janetta, is obviously very good with dogs that hate being clean. Thanks Janetta for making dreams come true!

I really am impressed with Paw Commons.   My daughter and her dog and also my two dogs have used the Hillcrest location for a few years.    It is clean, straightforward, respectful, and the staff seems to really love the animals.   When the babies were in daycare we regularly used their cameras to see how they were doing.   There seemed to be someone out in the kennel area with them interacting positively with them most of the time.

Our groomer Cassie is awesome.    Quite busy, but so worth the wait.   I’ve found it much easier to just schedule our groomings before we leave.  This way I stay on top of it (their hair grows fast and mats easily) and I don’t have to wait for Cassie either.    For two dogs I paid around $100 each and gave a
$30 tip for both.    Yes it is expensive, but what isn’t these days.   I’ve also groomed them myself many times and my back hurts for a week when I’m done.

I definitely recommend them and wouldn’t hesitate to take an animal there for boarding, daycare, or grooming.  💕

Was looking for a new dog daycare since my former daycare closed. My experience at Paw Commons in Hillcrest San Diego was fantastic.  We had a meet and greet where we learned about the facilities and the process that they would use to introduce my dog to the other dogs.  We received an update and report card, making us feel like everything was going well. Our dog came home tired from playing with his new daycare buddies. I highly recommend Paw Commons Hillcrest.

Best grooming experience me and my dog have had bar none! Love this place. Everyone there couldn't be nicer and their work is exceptional.
I want to reiterate how very much my dog, Bernardo (Bertolucci) and I truly appreciate the fantastic experience(s) we have had (as of today, April 14, 2026) at Paw Commons in Hillcrest. The staff there are friendly, simpatico and so very talented! They do an amazing, very thorough and thoughtful job of grooming. My (our) thanks to everyone at this wonderful establishment.
A special thanks to Cassie who takes on Bernie at every visit.
He looks great, smells great and always emerges a very happy fella.
Thank you very much Paw Commons and Cassie.
Loved hearing about Enzo’s first experience at Paw Commons. The pictures they shared with us show he was incredibly happy to be there!

We had a great experience with Paw Commons! This was our first time sending our dog to daycare and we were very hesitant, but they did an amazing job getting to know her and slowly introducing her to the rest of the doggos so she feels comfortable. I also appreciated how they had a midday report (for 1st time eval) to tell us how she was doing. We'll be back if we're ever in the area again!

The staff is so sweet and showed my dog with so much love and care. Ashley evaluated my dog during a meet and greet and was very sweet! I’m happy to have a backup place to take my pup that feels trustworthy and safe!

Our Pippin loves Paw Commons. He’s a social butterfly so it’s THE place for him. He’s been going since we rescued him and we felt comfortable enough after so many successful daycare days to board him for five days.

He had a wonderful time! We received updates via a little digital report card including photos of our boy. After his five days of boarding, he received an exit bath (excellent idea) and when we picked him up he was happy and sleepy.

Pros: Safe, secure, fun place for your social fur baby. The staff is kind, loves animals, remembers their name, and checks in regularly.
Cons: Maybe they come back a little stinky unless you purchase an exit bath (can’t recommend that enough!).

We will always choose Paw Commons. Thank you so much for taking care of our baby and special shout out to Jordan for being so communicative and kind!

Please see the photos we received while Pip was enjoying his stay. They are delightful ☺️

My sweet pug Jorge La Papa loves going to Paw Commons. He literally tries to jump out of the car as soon as he sees the building. The staff are very attentive and caring, and when Jorge had to take a few weeks off due to a bulging disc they were so nice and provided him a get well gift. He loved all the goodies he received and especially the card with so many signatures from some amazing people. I would recommend Paw Commons for all your pets needs. I

Cassie was great with our 13-year-old pup, especially for his first visit to Paw Commons. She was a great listener and our little guy easily walked with her to begin his spa day. Afterwards he was calm and looked awesome. We look forward to a monthly rhythm for his toenails and grooming needs, and we're confident he'll be happy to see her again. Here's before and after pics.

I went to get my dog evaluated for his boarding that is coming up. We had a fantastic behaviorist observe him and make suggestions. We are so happy with the recommendation and our puppy seemed to have had a great time overall.

We discovered this place a few months ago when we noticed we have an over energetic pup on our hands and little time for activities. Hands down the best place to take Voorhes. We did our on boarding with Ashley and our Voorhes absolutely adores the staff there. He runs on out the car and to the door the minute we park. He is well taken care of during daycare and is ready for a nap as soon as he gets home. Will never stop bringing him in its part of his weekly routine. Thank You to all the staff for keeping our dog happy.

My dog has been going to the Paw Commons Hillcrest location for about six months, and he loves it! He’s always excited to see his dog friends and the human staff. He also comes home exhausted, which is great for me.

Whether I drop him off for a few hours or a few days, I feel good knowing he’s safe hands. I cannot recommend Paw Commons enough!

Our beagle loves paw commons hillcrest! We have used similar camps for her , but by far have had the best experience here. I always catch the staff giving attention and love to the dogs throughout the day when I check in on the cameras. The staff really seem to love and care for the pups there. I look forward to dropping our dog off because I know how much fun she has there.

Jordan at the Hillcrest location was so helpful with my terrified puppy Lila!  He was patient and kind and they always give me great updates from the day of daycare. It’s really comforting that someone who cares so much is around while my puppy warms up to humans!  Thank you Jordan!

My fur babies love their visits to Paw Commons! They have a blast during playtime, and get all the cuddles they can from the staff. I feel comforted when Bella and Tony are in the staff's care when we are away and they always come home ready for a long nap because they've had many hours of excitement. I am very glad for Paw Commons and the care they provide!
